text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Tunisia on Monday started celebrations marking the foundation of Islamic Zitouna university 13th centuries ago. In a speech marking the occasion, President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali stressed the importance of modern Islam.
- Prime minister Hamed Karoui and his Moroccan counterpart Abdellatif Filali to co-chair meeting of the joint bilateral commission for cooperation.
